items.title: MECH-440 armed-stack falsifier at the raised candidate-diversity floor (708b design, class floor=action_dim, V3-EXQ-949 yoked divergence)
items.note: GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is committed_class_entropy_fraction_of_ceiling at a RAISED support_preserving_min_first_action_classes (=action_dim=5, vs 708b's hardcoded 2), combined with V3-EXQ-949-style yoked per-tick committed-action divergence + authority_rel_deviation_mean. Checked 708/708a/708b manifests: all record only the pre-commit-shape/class-entropy scalar AT THE DEFAULT FLOOR (2 classes); none combine a raised floor with a yoked measurement. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: 0 substrate_ceiling-category autopsies for MECH-440 in the corpus (2026-08-28 check) -- NOT braked. Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate: two OPEN corrupting substrate_queue entries name files this driver imports at module level -- mode-governance-engagement (not in this driver's causal path, no mode-governance knob enabled) and contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py; potentially in path via E1 but applies identically to every arm and interacts with neither the injection-site nor authority factor, biasing toward the null not a false positive) -- both carved out per the 949/947 drivers' identical precedent. Two OPEN degrading entries (mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism, SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING) also overlap causal_grid_world.py/agent.py/config.py -- noted, non-blocking. DESIGN: V3-EXQ-708b's design (same 3 arms A0_OFF/ARM_TEMP/ARM_NOISE_SINGLE, same matched SOTA conversion stack incl. use_modulatory_selection_authority=True, same 6 seeds, same P0=100/P1=50 phased training) with support_preserving_min_first_action_classes raised from 2 to action_dim, PLUS the V3-EXQ-949 yoked-pair/private-RNG-stream mechanism for P2 (reference=A0_OFF's trained agent drives the env; ARM_TEMP/ARM_NOISE_SINGLE's trained agents step on the identical observation sequence) so the run measures whether a lever that moves the pre-commit distribution shape ever reaches the COMMITTED action -- closing 708b's own honest limit ("the shape/entropy scalar cannot tell moved-the-shape from moved-the-outcome"). ARMED-CONVERSION P1 (mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 0.9 * action_dim, every arm) and P2 (authority_rel_deviation_mean > 0.05, lever-bearing arms) are MEASURED readiness gates, not assumptions; VACUITY RULE self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue if either is unmet, per V3-EXQ-949's confirmed strict-AND precedent. CEILING-HEADROOM CHECK on A0_OFF (fraction-of-ceiling < 0.90) gates the falsifying branch. PASS: ARM_NOISE_SINGLE's committed_class_entropy_fraction_of_ceiling strictly above ARM_TEMP's AND its yoked divergence vs A0_OFF clears 0.02, both on >=2/3 of >=4 divergent seeds. SECONDARY state-conditioning/self-annealing checks (per-state noise magnitude covaries with state; per-parameter sigma anneals with confidence) are NOT measured by this run -- recorded honestly as secondary_checks_measured=false; a PASS here establishes propagation only, leaving two-thirds of MECH-440 untested. SCOPE: does not refute MECH-439 F-dominance or ARC-110's intrinsic-ceiling finding; both may still hold at a raised floor -- a null here is a genuine result for the first time. SMOKE: --dry-run PASS (run twice, under the ID renames forced by live concurrent-session ID collisions on V3-EXQ-953 and V3-EXQ-954 -- see completion_note). validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings). INSTRUMENT CONTROL self-yoke divergence = 0.000000 for all 3 arms (RNG isolation verified). z_goal_stream: writer_calls=273, active_frac=0.000 -- no writer defect (benefit gate correctly never opened on this tiny/short smoke). estimated_minutes calibrated directly from V3-EXQ-708b's OWN landed manifest (elapsed_seconds=58218.87 = 16.2h for the identical arms/seeds/P0/P1/P2 episode budget on ree-worker-1), +~40% for this design's added yoked-3-runner P2 pass + self-yoke control checks. Raised as GFLAG-0072 (evidence_discrepancy), 2026-08-28; proposal EXP-0593 / backlog_id EVB-0651 in manual_proposals.v1.json.

items.title: ContextMemory gumbel_learned write-address selection: real-agent validation of content-discrimination under real training (THIRD mechanism, substrate readiness, not a claim test)
items.note: Validates the THIRD write-address mechanism for substrate_queue contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (severity corrupting, status implemented_pending_validation), contextmemory_write_selection="gumbel_learned" (built 2026-08-27, chip-20260826-contextmemory-gumbel-writeselect-build), under the same REAL-agent harness V3-EXQ-943 used for the other two mechanisms (BIAS/REFRACTORY, done). Unlike those two, gumbel_learned ships a real, verified gradient path (ContextMemory.compute_write_addressing_loss via the new top-level REEConfig.contextmemory_write_addressing_loss_weight, gated on weight>0 AND write_selection==gumbel_learned) whose content-discrimination effect is UNPROVEN -- a toy 300-step SGD script did not move the loss off its near-uniform starting point (architecture doc, 'THIRD mechanism' section). This experiment is the first to run the loss through a REAL training schedule under a REAL agent. 3 arms x 5 seeds (seeds match V3-EXQ-943/436-family: 42,7,13,100,200): LEGACY (write_selection=argmin, reference/floor, non-gating), GUMBEL_UNTRAINED (gumbel_learned, loss weight=0.0 -- tagger stays at random init all run), GUMBEL_TRAINED (gumbel_learned, loss weight=0.5, mirroring sd016_diversification_weight's own validated 0.5 operating point -- same mean-squared-off-diagonal-cosine-similarity loss FORM applied to per-example write-address selection distributions instead of memory rows, the closest available precedent). TWO separate measurement families, both required (occupancy alone is insufficient -- already proven decisive at the unit level even fully untrained, via Gumbel noise alone): (1) OCCUPANCY, from real training-mode writes, C1: n_occupied_slots>=2 in BOTH GUMBEL arms on >=3/5 seeds, P0-gated on n_write_calls>=200/cell. (2) CONTENT-DISCRIMINATION (the actually open question), measured post-training via a dedicated eval-mode probe reusing the CONTRACT TEST'S OWN 2-cluster synthetic instrument verbatim (test_contextmemory_write_address_selection.py's _stream/_jaccard, LATENT_DIM=64=self_dim(32)+world_dim(32), asserted equal at construction) fed directly into context_memory.write() after training completes, isolating what write_addr_tagger has learned from Gumbel-noise contamination (eval mode = deterministic argmin on the tagger's own scores). C2: mean_jaccard(GUMBEL_TRAINED) <= mean_jaccard(GUMBEL_UNTRAINED) - 0.25 across 5 seeds (mean, not per-seed -- test_refractory_preserves_content_conditioning's own docstring documents why a per-seed Jaccard margin at n=5 is sign-inconsistent/unstable; 0.25 margin mirrors that same contract's convention), gated on a C2-readiness precondition (mean_jaccard(GUMBEL_UNTRAINED)>=0.25, so a near-zero untrained baseline cannot make 'materially lower' structurally unsatisfiable and get misread as training failure). PASS iff C1 AND C2. A FAIL on C2 alone (C1 passes, precondition met) is a real, scientifically valid, expected-possible outcome per the architecture doc's own toy-script finding -- not a bug. Mechanical negative/positive controls (non-gating): write_addr_tagger state_dict byte-identical to init across the whole run for GUMBEL_UNTRAINED (weight=0.0 -> loss never added to backward graph) vs measurably moved for GUMBEL_TRAINED. BUG FIX discovered and fixed while authoring this driver: V3-EXQ-943's own episode runner never called agent._e1_tick(), which was harmless there (BIAS/REFRACTORY occupancy comes entirely from sense()'s SD-016 per-tick write hook) but is NOT harmless here -- compute_prediction_loss() returns an unconditional zero_loss whenever _world_experience_buffer has <2 entries, and that buffer is populated only inside _e1_tick; confirmed empirically that without this fix, compute_prediction_loss() returned exactly 0.0 on every step and GUMBEL_TRAINED's tagger showed byte-identical zero movement from init (i.e. the addressing loss was silently never trained regardless of weight). This driver adds the agent.clock.advance()-gated _e1_tick() call experiments/_harness.py already uses for other custom-action-selection diagnostics. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (2-cluster content-discrimination Jaccard for a TRAINED gumbel_learned tagger under real agent dynamics) recorded nowhere -- the unit-level contract (untrained tagger, no REEAgent) and V3-EXQ-943 (BIAS/REFRACTORY only, never constructs write_addr_tagger) are both incompatible substrates for this question; not recoverable -> run. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: N/A, claim_ids=[]. Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap: open corrupting entry mode-governance-engagement lists ree_core/agent.py (whole-file), which this driver necessarily imports (REEAgent); removed by construction, identical disposition to V3-EXQ-943/942/949/947 precedent -- driver never sets use_salience_coordinator=True and never reads operating_mode/SalienceCoordinator output. contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy itself (e1_deep.py) is the entry under test, not an unrelated one. No other open corrupting entry's substrate_paths overlaps this driver. claim_ids=[] -- validates substrate readiness for the write-address FIX itself, not the SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166 sleep-differentiation claims this substrate_queue entry unblocks once validated; evidence_direction non_contributory regardless of outcome. No sleep loop (SD-016 sleep-cycle consolidation is orthogonal, per the architecture doc). Does NOT flip substrate_queue status regardless of outcome -- stays a human/governance disposition; this script only appends a validation_record once it has actually run. SMOKE: validate_experiments.py --strict OK, 0 warnings (re-verified after the QUEUE_ID rename below). --dry-run (1 seed, 2ep x5steps) OK, exit 0, correctly self-routes to FAIL/substrate_not_ready_requeue at toy scale (P0 unmet, n=1 seed < 3 required). TIMING CALIBRATION: measured directly (not reused from V3-EXQ-943's stale figure, which ran the pre-fix zero-gradient path and is not comparable) -- one real cell (GUMBEL_TRAINED, 10 episodes x150 steps, seed 42) took 284.5s wall-clock including import/construction overhead; linear extrapolation to the full 100-episode x15-cell run gives ~710min, +~25% margin for cloud-worker variance and the post-training probe overhead (cheap per-cell but x15) -> estimated_minutes=900. ID HISTORY: authored and committed by a prior incarnation of this same chip/worktree (chip-20260827-queueexp-contextmemory-gumbel-learned-validation) under a tentative id 'V3-EXQ-953' while experiment_queue.json was held by a concurrent session (igw-236-confirm-evidence-mech-267-lit-0); that number was independently claimed by a DIFFERENT driver in the same window (E1 rollout horizon sweep, later renamed 953->954->955, see V3-EXQ-955's own note) and by the time this session picked the work back up the queue's live max was 955, so this entry (script + queue_id + EXPERIMENT_TYPE, all three) was renamed 953->956 at write time and re-smoke-tested clean under the new name before this append.
